title: Insight Pump data not shown on Nightscout
symptom: The user reports that AndroidAPS connects to the Accu-Chek Insight pump, collects data, and the NS Client uploads data to Nightscout, but pump-related data is not shown. All other data uploads correctly.
cause: The thread does not establish a definitive root cause. The user speculates it might be a bug related to VPN routing, where pump data is not uploaded when using OpenVPN, but this is not confirmed.
fix: The user found that rebooting the phone after disconnecting from VPN caused the pump data to appear in Nightscout. No permanent fix is provided.
evidence_quote: As soon as I disconnect from VPN and restart the phone, the pump data is uploaded correctly, but in this case Diabox cannot upload the BG results to NS.
